summary: Preserve Node path.basename platform grammar and optional case-sensitive suffix removal.

requirements.arguments: value and optional suffix proven strings
requirements.path_flavor: default host, posix, or win32 is statically known

target.notes: Do not substitute System.IO.Path.GetFileName: Node has its own POSIX/win32 lexical grammar and suffix-removal rules.

semantics.suffix: removed only when it exactly matches the end of the basename; comparison is case-sensitive even for win32 flavor
semantics.exceptions: TypeError for non-string path or suffix

caveats: This is a lexical operation; it does not query the filesystem.
Windows filesystem case-insensitivity does not make suffix matching case-insensitive.
